extraction.title: Comprehensive workflow reminder management for booking lifecycle events
extraction.head: workflow-queue-enhanced

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding a cancelled flag to the WorkflowReminder schema, updating the email and SMS reminder managers, centralizing cancellation logic, and adding a cron cleanup in scheduleEmailReminders.ts. Confidence score of 2/5, citing incorrect Prisma typing, forEach with async race conditions, and missing error handling that could break booking flows.
Syntax: workflowRemindersToDelete is typed as an array of Prisma client promises; it should be Promise<WorkflowReminder>[]. Suggests changing the type annotation accordingly.
Logic: the SendGrid cancel request loop uses reminder.referenceId without a null check, which would cause SendGrid API errors when it is null.

Style: the forEach loop over originalRescheduledBooking.workflowReminders calls deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder without awaiting them; they should be awaited so deletions finish before the reschedule proceeds.

Logic: forEach with async callbacks causes race conditions and does not wait for completion. Suggests Promise.all with map or a for...of loop, and shows a refactor using Promise.all over remindersToUpdate.

Logic: the forEach calls that delete scheduled reminders are not awaited, so the workflow could be deleted before reminders are cancelled, leaving orphaned reminders. Suggests wrapping them in Promise.all with map.
Logic: when immediateDelete is true, only the SendGrid cancellation runs and the database record remains, which could leave orphaned records if callers expect cleanup.
Style: the new cancelled BOOLEAN column has no default value; suggests adding a default (likely FALSE) for consistent behavior on existing and new rows.
